Study Plan
for Special Undergraduate Students and Special Graduate Students


- Students who only meet the NUPACE English language requirement should complete this form in English. 
- Students who only meet the Japanese language requirement should complete it in Japanese. / 日本語の言語能力基準のみを満たしている場合は、日本語で記入してください。 
- Students who meet both English and Japanese language requirements can enter the requisite information either in English or Japanese. 

Reason for Choosing Your First Choice School/Graduate School
Explain why you have chosen the prospective School/Graduate School as your first choice up to 100 words (English) or 200 characters (Japanese). You will be affiliated with a School/Graduate School that closely matches your major field of study. 

Academic Interests
Describe your academic interests as they relate to your major field of study up to 300 words (English) or 600 characters (Japanese). 

Courses of Interest at Nagoya University
Provide the names of the courses that you are interested in registering for at Nagoya University. 
Please refer to the course lists available at the following links: 
<English-taught courses> https://nupace.iee.nagoya-u.ac.jp/en/academic/overview.html 
<Japanese-taught courses> https://nupace.iee.nagoya-u.ac.jp/ja/academic/overview.html 
(Please note that courses may be subject to change.)

Each semester, special undergraduate students are required to take at least one or two courses related to their major. Special graduate students are expected to take at least three or four courses relevant to their research or academic focus. 
Provided that you meet the academic requirements, you may also register for courses offered by the Schools or Graduate Schools other than your own.
NB: Special undergraduate students and special graduate students are required to earn a minimum of 15 NU credits per semester or 30 credits per year.

Requirements from Your Home University
4-1. Do you need to transfer credit in your Major to your home university? 	Yes/No

4-2. Do you need to transfer credit in your “electives” to your home university?	Yes/No

4-3. Describe requirements set by your home university, if any.

Research Interests at Nagoya University <Graduate Students only>
List the name of a faculty member or laboratory whose research is of interest at Nagoya University, if any.


Courses Taken at Your Home University
List the names of courses that you have taken/will take at your home university in the last semester prior to your exchange at Nagoya University.

Non-Academic Goals
Beyond your academic studies, please describe anything you would like to pursue, achieve, or experience during your stay in Japan.
